title: 34 RATE OF L&SL CRIMES DURING 1992 1.11.2 Uttar Pradesh, Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, Madhya Pradesh and Punjab together recorded around 77 per cent of the crimes reported under the 'N.D.P.S. Act'. Uttar Pradesh also recorded 63.6 per cent of the cases reported under the 'Arms Act'. Tamil Nadu, Gujarat and Maharashtra together cover almost all the cases (99.9%) registered under the 'Prohibition Act', in the country. The state of Jammu & Kashmir alone recorded 77.3 per cent of the total cases registered in the country under the 'TADA Act'.
